faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DLSA Indore Para-Legal Volunteer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the DLSA Indore Para-Legal Volunteer posts is 17th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum age requirement for the Para-Legal Volunteer post?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement for the Para-Legal Volunteer post is 21 years. Candidates must meet this age criterion to be eligible for the recruitment.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required for the Para-Legal Volunteer position?
faq.answer: Candidates who have passed the 10th standard are eligible to apply for the Para-Legal Volunteer position. This is the minimum educational qualification required.

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be selected for the Para-Legal Volunteer role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Para-Legal Volunteer post will be based on an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted and called for an interview to assess their suitability.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Para-Legal Volunteer post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Para-Legal Volunteer post will receive a salary of Rs. 750/- per day, with a maximum of 10 days of work per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the DLSA Indore Para-Legal Volunteer recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for the DLSA Indore Para-Legal Volunteer recruitment. Candidates from all categories, including General, OBC, SC, and ST, are exempt from paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the DLSA Indore Para-Legal Volunteer recruitment is offline. Interested candidates need to download the application form and send it to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for the Para-Legal Volunteer position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Para-Legal Volunteer position is contractual. This means the appointment will be for a fixed period as per the terms and conditions of the DLSA Indore.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for DLSA Indore Para-Legal Volunteer recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification for the DLSA Indore Para-Legal Volunteer recruitment can be found in the "Important Links" section of this article. It is recommended to download and read it thoroughly.

faq.answer: The notification specifies the District Legal Services Authority Indore as the recruiting body. While not explicitly stated, it is generally advisable for candidates to check the official notification for any domicile requirements.
